title.zh: Coinbase Q3财报：营收约12.16亿美元同比降35%，调整后EBITDA约3.33亿美元
title.en: Coinbase Q3财报：营收约12.16亿美元同比降35%，调整后EBITDA约3.33亿美元

current_state.zh: Coinbase reported Q3 revenue of about $1.216 billion, down 35% year over year, with net income of $719 million boosted by investment gains and adjusted EBITDA of $333 million, as spot trading volumes fell sharply while derivatives and prediction markets grew.
